jobs.description:
Start your technical career in the Netherlands Are you an experienced Maintenance Technician based in Portugal and ready for an international step in your career? Xelvin is looking for motivated technical professionals who want to relocate to the Netherlands and work in industrial maintenance, production technology or technical service environments. In this role, you will work as part of a technical department and help keep machines, production lines and installations running smoothly. You will solve technical issues, carry out preventive maintenance and contribute to a safe, reliable and efficient production process. This position is suitable for technicians with experience in industrial maintenance, mechanics, electromechanics, automation or technical service. What you will do As a Maintenance Technician, you are responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving technical installations and production equipment. You will work in a practical, hands-on environment where no two days are the same. Your responsibilities may include: Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on machines, production lines and technical installations. Diagnosing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic faults. Repairing and replacing machine parts, sensors, motors, pumps, conveyors or other technical components. Supporting production teams when technical problems occur. Carrying out inspections and basic testing of equipment. Reading and using technical drawings, electrical diagrams or machine documentation. Registering maintenance activities and technical findings. Thinking along about improvements in reliability, safety and efficiency. Working according to safety standards and company procedures. Cooperating with colleagues from production, engineering and technical service. Depending on your experience, the role can be more mechanically, electrically or electromechanically focused. What Xelvin offers you Relocating to another country is a big step. Xelvin supports you

throughout the process, from the first interview to your first working day in the Netherlands. We offer: A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A competitive gross monthly salary between €2,800 and €4,200, depending on your experience, technical background and the type of company. Possible shift allowance, depending on the working schedule and production environment. 25 paid holidays, in addition to Dutch public holidays. 8.33% holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Support with your relocation from Portugal to the Netherlands. Assistance with documentation needed to work in the Netherlands. Guidance from our housing consultant in finding accommodation. Support during onboarding and your first period in the Netherlands. Personal guidance from Xelvin. Opportunities for training, courses and career development. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for practical technicians with a solid technical education and hands-on experience in an industrial environment. You have: A technical education such as Curso Técnico Profissional / Nível 4 or higher in one of the following areas: Mecatrónica Manutenção Industrial Eletromecânica Eletrotecnia Automação Mecânica Industrial Technology or similar At least 2 years of experience in industrial maintenance, technical service, production maintenance or machine maintenance. Good mechanical and/or electrical troubleshooting skills. Experience with industrial equipment, production lines, machinery or automated systems. Basic knowledge of electrical, mechanical, pneumatic or hydraulic systems. The ability to read technical drawings or electrical schematics is a strong advantage. Experience with PLC-controlled machinery is a plus, but not always required. A practical, hands-on mindset. A safe and responsible way of working. Job description Are you an ambitious Instrumentation Technician (E&I) from South Africa who is ready to build an international career in the Netherlands? Xelvin is looking for talented technicians who want to work in one of Europe's leading petrochemical environments. As an Instrumentation Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, calibrating and troubleshooting instrumentation and electrical systems that are essential for safe and reliable plant operations. You will join a highly skilled maintenance team where safety, quality and continuous improvement are key priorities. This position is based in Geleen, one of the largest industrial and petrochemical hubs in the Netherlands. Your responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on instrumentation and electrical systems. Calibrate pressure, temperature, flow and level transmitters. Troubleshoot electrical and instrumentation faults. Install and commission new field instrumentation. Read and interpret P&IDs, loop drawings and electrical schematics. Assist during plant shutdowns and turnarounds. Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and quality standards. Contribute to improving plant reliability and equipment performance. Employment conditions At Xelvin, we do much more than help you find a job. We help you build a future in the Netherlands. You can expect: A salary between €3,800 and €4,700 gross per month Full-time employment with long-term career opportunities Overtime and shift allowances where applicable 25 vacation days plus holiday allowance Pension scheme Extensive training and development opportunities Personal guidance throughout your career Complete relocation support Moving to another country is a big step. That's why Xelvin supports you throughout the entire relocation process. Our relocation package includes: Work visa and residence permit support Assistance with finding suitable accommodation Flight to the Netherlands Airport pick-up Municipal registration (BSN)

Opening a Dutch bank account Health insurance guidance Dutch language lessons Ongoing support from your dedicated Xelvin Consultant Job requirements We are looking for motivated professionals who are ready to take the next step in their international career. You have: A recognised trade qualification in Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I), Instrumentation or Electrical Engineering. Experience as an Instrumentation Technician or E&I Technician. Experience within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical or Chemical industry. Knowledge of process instrumentation, control valves and field devices. Experience reading P&IDs and electrical drawings. Good English communication skills. Afrikaans language skills (preferred). A proactive attitude and willingness to relocate to the Netherlands. Preferably between 23 and 28 years old, making this an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals looking to build an international career. About the organisation Xelvin has over 20 years of experience in connecting technical professionals with leading companies throughout the Netherlands. Every year we help engineers and technicians from South Africa relocate successfully to the Netherlands, where they build long-term careers with international employers. Xelvin provides comprehensive relocation assistance, from immigration support to housing and settling into Dutch life. Our client operates in one of Europe's largest petrochemical clusters and is committed to innovation, safety and sustainability. You will work with modern technologies in an international environment where technical expertise is highly valued.
